when_to_use: 移动端友好、零依赖的原生下拉
prompt_en: Build a single styled Native Select, not a full page. Structure: a real <select> element styled to match the design system: custom border, radius, and a chevron overlay while keeping native behavior. Interaction: native open/select behavior, change updates a readout line. States: default, focus, disabled, option selected. Motion: none (native). Do not rebuild the dropdown panel in JS. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个样式化原生下拉，不是整页。结构：真实的 <select> 元素，外观与设计系统一致：自定义边框、圆角、叠加箭头符号，但保留原生行为。交互：原生展开/选择行为，变更后更新一行读数。状态：默认、聚焦、禁用、选项已选。动效：无（原生）。不要用 JS 重写下拉面板。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 选项需要按类别分组展示
prompt_en: Build a single Grouped Select dropdown, not a full page. Structure: a trigger opening a listbox where options are grouped under non-selectable muted group headers (Frontend: React, Vue; Backend: Go, Python). Interaction: click to select, headers are inert. States: group header, option hover, selected. Motion: 150ms fade. Do not make headers selectable. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个分组下拉，不是整页。结构：触发器展开列表框，选项按不可选的灰色组头分组（前端：React、Vue；后端：Go、Python）。交互：点选项选中，组头不可点。状态：组头、选项悬停、已选。动效：150ms 淡入。组头不可被选中。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 表单里需要图标提示字段含义
prompt_en: Build a single Select with Prefix Icon, not a full page. Structure: the trigger contains a small leading glyph (globe) before the placeholder text and a chevron at the right. Interaction: standard select open/select. States: default, open, selected, disabled. Motion: 150ms fade. Do not place the icon outside the trigger box. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个带前缀图标的下拉，不是整页。结构：触发器内占位文字前有小图标（地球），右侧有箭头。交互：标准下拉展开/选择。状态：默认、展开、已选、禁用。动效：150ms 淡入。图标不要放在触发框外面。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。

when_to_use: 工具栏/表格行内的小尺寸下拉
prompt_en: Build a single Compact Select, not a full page. Structure: a small-height (28px) select trigger with 12px text, chevron tight to the edge, and a compact menu. Interaction: standard select behavior. States: default, open, selected. Motion: 150ms fade. Do not use a full-size trigger. If a design system exists, map colors to its tokens but keep this structure. No extra page chrome, no emoji.
prompt_zh: 做一个迷你下拉，不是整页。结构：矮高度（28px）的下拉触发器，12px 文字，箭头贴边，菜单同样紧凑。交互：标准下拉行为。状态：默认、展开、已选。动效：150ms 淡入。不要用全尺寸触发器。若项目已有设计系统，颜色取自 token，结构和交互保持不变。不要页面级装饰，不要 emoji。
